newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Rugby league-ABC becomes second Super League carrier.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Rugby league-ABC becomes second Super League carrier.

text.p: The Australian Broadcasting Corporation (ABC) had won the rights to be the second free-to-air television broadcaster for Super League matches this year, Super League chief executive John Ribot said on Friday.
Ribot said in a statement the government-funded ABC would replay one Super League match nationally each Sunday.
"We felt it was very important to ensure rugby league fans throughout regional and country areas had the opportunity to watch our games on television in 1997," Ribot said.
The ABC would also carry replays of Super League world club championship matches, Ribot said.
Super League announced on Thursday that the commercial Channel Nine network had won free-to-air broadcast rights for Super League matches on Monday nights.

Kerry Packer's Channel Nine already holds broadcast rights for the rival Australian Rugby League (ARL) and had been a major backer of the ARL in its long battle for control of the sport with Super League and media tycoon Rupert Murdoch's News Ltd.
